brand_names: Sel PH Baby PH-Balanced Eczema Dryness Baby
purpose: This product is used to soothe and moisturize your baby's dry, itchy, or eczema-prone skin. It helps relieve the discomfort caused by dryness and skin irritation. It is specially made to be gentle and safe for a baby's delicate skin.
how_it_works: This lotion contains colloidal oatmeal and gentle moisturizing ingredients that form a protective barrier on your baby's skin to lock in moisture. It helps restore the skin's natural pH balance, which keeps the skin healthy and less prone to irritation. The soothing ingredients calm redness and itchiness so your baby feels more comfortable.
common_side_effects: This product is generally very well tolerated by babies. In rare cases, some babies may experience mild redness, a rash, or minor irritation at the spot where it was applied. If you notice any of these, stop using the product and talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
warnings: For external use only — keep away from your baby's eyes and mouth. Do not use on broken, infected, or open skin without checking with your doctor first. If your baby's skin condition worsens or does not improve after a week of use, contact your pediatrician. Always do a small patch test on a small area of skin first to check for any allergic reaction before applying broadly.
typical_dosing: Gently apply a small amount of lotion to your baby's dry or irritated skin areas as needed, typically 1 to 3 times per day or after bath time. Pat the skin dry gently with a soft towel before applying. Use as much as needed to cover the affected area with a thin, even layer. Always follow the directions on the product label or as advised by your baby's doctor.
